name: io.github.sekharsdet/five46
description: BYOK, fully local AI agent that tests your app/API and writes a real Playwright spec on success.
title: five46

environmentVariables.name: FIVE46_LLM_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: LLM provider to use: openai, anthropic, gemini, groq, or bedrock

environmentVariables.name: FIVE46_LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own API key for the chosen provider (for bedrock, your AWS region instead)

environmentVariables.name: FIVE46_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to unlock POST/PUT/PATCH for the five46_api tool (read-only by default)

environmentVariables.name: FIVE46_MCP_ALLOW_DELETES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to unlock DELETE (five46_api) and destructive-looking browser clicks (five46_test)

environmentVariables.name: FIVE46_MCP_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Max concurrent scenarios for story mode (default: 2 for five46_test, 3 for five46_api; hard-capped at 5)
